title: Group-based Intervention for Club Patrons
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to develop and test a group-based strategy for encouraging groups of young adults who are engaged in party behaviors at nightclubs to intervene with each other to reduce harms associated with overuse of alcohol and recreational drugs and to reduce harms associated with aggression (physical and sexual).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Must be within age range, entering the club that night, group size must be 2 or more

Exclusion Criteria:

* working or performing at the club that night
